text:
Seven tools preserve every existing stable identity while replacing the manual template chain with visible, independent print drafts.

- `ask_storefront` returns real tray, draft, template-slot, proof, cart, and sandbox state.
- `find_prints` resolves natural language to published canonical products.
- `configure_print` creates or patches one draft, selects the remembered or first compatible template, assigns exact nodes, and updates local crops.
- `request_server_proof` starts explicit asynchronous JPEG proofing.
- `add_to_cart` asynchronously finalizes one complete draft and keeps the boundary reversible.
- `manage_cart` corrects only local cart lines.
- `prepare_sandbox_order` stops at Test Mode review and quoting.

Supporting UI: a persistent preferred template, a visible draft rail with one expanded preview, optional IndexedDB directory-handle recovery without caching image bytes, and no WebMCP file reordering or deletion. Review or comment on any tool, then submit the plan when it matches your intent.
The developer approved the finalized plan in the original task. Build started with the approved seven-tool contract and the existing npm dependency lock preserved.
